# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Plus traefik-route module for self-service routing.
# =============================================================================

module "n8n" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = 502

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores          = 2
  memory         = 2048
  swap           = 1024
  rootfs_size    = 8
  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Container options - unprivileged for security
  unprivileged = true
  template     = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "Workflow automation platform"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.n8n}:5678/"
  }
  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]
  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "n8n_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.n8n.container_id
  container_ip   = module.n8n.ip_address
  container_name = "n8n"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-502"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "SQLite backup"
      command = "cp /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite.backup"
      timeout = 60
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,n8n"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["n8n"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["n8n"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.n8n]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "n8n_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "n8n"
  backend_url = "http://${module.n8n.ip_address}:5678"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "n8n.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.n8n]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.n8n.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.n8n.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.n8n.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.n8n_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.n8n.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.n8n_route.remote_config_path
}

   227→```

   230→[2025-12-18 02:00:02]   - PostgreSQL dump

   233→[2025-12-18 02:15:32] ✓ Backup completed successfully in 927s
   234→[2025-12-18 02:15:33] Pruning old backups (keep 7)...
   235→[2025-12-18 02:15:35] ✓ Prune completed
   236→[2025-12-18 02:15:36] === Backup Completed Successfully ===
   237→```

   240→
   241→1. PBS container (102) running and accessible at 10.100.1.102
   242→2. PBS server configured with:
   243→   - Datastore "homelab"
   244→   - User "backup@pbs" with DatastoreBackup permissions
   245→   - Password stored in 1Password

   248→

   250→
   251→### Backup fails with "authentication failed"
   252→
   253→Check PBS password is correct:
   254→```bash
   255→export PBS_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')

   258→
   259→### Pre-backup hook fails

   261→Check the command syntax and timeout:
   262→```bash
   263→ssh root@<container-ip> "docker exec <container> <command>"

   265→
   266→### Timer not triggering

   269→```bash
   270→ssh root@<container-ip> "systemctl list-timers --all | grep pbs-backup"
   271→```

# LXC Sidecars Module

Manages sidecar services for LXC containers including backup, monitoring, and log collection.

## Features

### Current
- **Backup**: Zero-downtime incremental backups using proxmox-backup-client (PBS)
  - Pre-backup hooks for database dumps
  - Automated pruning and retention
  - File-based logging for future Promtail collection
  - ntfy alerts on failure

### Future
- **DIUN**: Docker image update notifications
- **Promtail**: Log collection for Loki
- **cAdvisor**: Container metrics collection

## Usage

### Basic Backup Configuration

```hcl
module "app_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.app.container_id
  container_ip   = module.app.ip_address
  container_name = "myapp"

  proxmox_ssh_host            = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"          # or "02:00" or "Sun 03:00"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "myapp"

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]
  }
}
```

### With Database Pre-Backup Hooks

#### PostgreSQL Example

```hcl
backup = {
  enabled   = true
  schedule  = "daily"
  retention = "7"
  namespace = "immich"

  pre_backup_commands = [{
    name    = "PostgreSQL dump"
    command = "docker exec immich_postgres pg_dump -U immich -d immich --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/immich-db-backup.sql.gz"
    timeout = 600
  }]

  include_paths = ["/config"]
  exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2", "/config/cache/**"]

  ntfy_priority = "high"
  ntfy_tags     = "backup,immich,rotating_light"
}
```

#### SQLite Example

```hcl
backup = {
  enabled   = true
  schedule  = "daily"
  retention = "7"
  namespace = "openwebui"

  pre_backup_commands = [{
    name    = "SQLite backup"
    command = "cp /config/openwebui/webui.db /config/openwebui/webui.db.backup"
    timeout = 60
  }]

  include_paths = ["/config"]
  exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]
}
```

### Config-Only Backup (No Database)

```hcl
backup = {
  enabled   = true
  schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly
  retention = "4"
  namespace = "traefik"

  pre_backup_commands = []  # No database

  include_paths = ["/config"]
  exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]
}
```

## Variables

### Required

| Variable | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `container_id` | number | LXC container ID |
| `container_ip` | string | Container IP address (without CIDR) |
| `container_name` | string | Container hostname |
| `proxmox_ssh_host` | string | Proxmox host SSH address |
| `proxmox_ssh_private_key_path` | string | Path to SSH private key |

### Backup Configuration

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `backup.enabled` | bool | - | Enable backup sidecar |
| `backup.schedule` | string | - | "daily", "HH:MM", or "day HH:MM" |
| `backup.retention` | string | "7" | Number of backups to keep |
| `backup.namespace` | string | - | PBS namespace (usually container name) |
| `backup.pre_backup_commands` | list(object) | [] | Commands to run before backup |

| `backup.ntfy_priority` | string | "default" | Alert priority |
| `backup.ntfy_tags` | string | "backup" | Alert tags |

### Pre-Backup Command Object

```hcl
{
  name    = string  # Description of the command
  command = string  # Shell command to execute
  timeout = number  # Timeout in seconds (default: 300)
}
```

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `backup_enabled` | Whether backup is enabled |
| `backup_namespace` | PBS backup namespace |
| `backup_schedule` | Backup schedule |
| `backup_timer_name` | Systemd timer unit name |
| `backup_log_path` | Backup log file path |

## Schedule Formats

The `schedule` parameter accepts multiple formats:

- `"daily"` → Runs once per day (systemd picks time)
- `"02:00"` → Runs daily at 2:00 AM
- `"Sun 03:00"` → Runs Sunday at 3:00 AM
- `"mon 18:00"` → Runs Monday at 6:00 PM

## Manual Operations

### Trigger Backup Manually

```bash
ssh root@<container-ip> "systemctl start pbs-backup-<id>.service"
```

### Check Timer Status

```bash
ssh root@<container-ip> "systemctl list-timers pbs-backup-<id>.timer"
```

### View Logs

```bash
ssh root@<container-ip> "tail -f /var/log/pbs-backups/<namespace>.log"
```

### Test Restore

```bash
# List available backups
ssh root@<container-ip> "proxmox-backup-client list \
  --repository backup@pbs@10.100.1.102:homelab \
  --ns <namespace>"

# Restore to test location
ssh root@<container-ip> "proxmox-backup-client restore \
  --repository backup@pbs@10.100.1.102:homelab \
  --ns <namespace> \
  lxc-<id>/<snapshot> /tmp/restore-test"
```

## Architecture

```
OpenTofu applies lxc-sidecars module
  └─> ansible_navigator_run resource
      ├─> Connects to LXC via SSH
      ├─> Installs proxmox-backup-client
      ├─> Creates backup script from template
      ├─> Sets up systemd service & timer
      └─> Enables and starts timer

Systemd timer triggers service
  └─> Backup script executes
      ├─> Runs pre-backup commands (database dumps)
      ├─> Calls proxmox-backup-client
      ├─> Prunes old backups
      ├─> Cleans up temporary files
      └─> Sends ntfy alert on failure
```

## Logging

Logs are written to `/var/log/pbs-backups/<namespace>.log` for future collection by Promtail.

Log format:
```

[2025-12-18 02:15:35] ✓ Prune completed

```

## Prerequisites

1. PBS container (102) running and accessible at 10.100.1.102
2. PBS server configured with:
   - Datastore "homelab"
   - User "backup@pbs" with DatastoreBackup permissions
   - Password stored in 1Password
3. LXC container has network access to PBS server
4. SSH access configured for Ansible

## Troubleshooting

### Backup fails with "authentication failed"

Check PBS password is correct:
```bash
export PBS_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
ssh root@<container-ip> "PBS_PASSWORD='$PBS_PASSWORD' proxmox-backup-client login --repository backup@pbs@10.100.1.102:homelab"
```

### Pre-backup hook fails

Check the command syntax and timeout:
```bash

```

### Timer not triggering

```bash
ssh root@<container-ip> "systemctl list-timers --all | grep pbs-backup"
```

      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:12.3.1
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
      # OAuth/OIDC via Authentik
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ENABLED=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_NAME=Authentik
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_SCOPES=openid email profile
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_AUTH_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_AUTH_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_API_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_API_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_AUTO_LOGIN=false
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_USE_PKCE=true
      - GF_AUTH_SIGNOUT_REDIRECT_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_SIGNOUT_URL}
      # Attribute mappings for user info from Authentik (using JMESPath)
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=email
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=preferred_username || email
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_NAME_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=name || preferred_username
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.15.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ./ntfy/templates:/etc/ntfy/templates:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

# =============================================================================
# Configure Container Management Agents in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It deploys all enabled agents in a single docker-compose file to avoid
# conflicts from separate compose projects removing each other's containers.
#
# Agents:
#   - Pulse Docker Agent: Container monitoring (pushes metrics to Pulse server)
#   - Arcane Agent: Remote container management (manager initiates pairing)
#   - Alloy Agent: Grafana Alloy for log collection to Loki
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure container agents for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: "${container_id}"
    container_name: "${container_name}"

    # Pulse agent config
    pulse_enabled: ${pulse_enabled}
    pulse_url: "${pulse_url}"
    pulse_token: "${pulse_token}"

    # Arcane agent config
    arcane_enabled: ${arcane_enabled}
    manager_url: "${manager_url}"
    bootstrap_token: "${bootstrap_token}"

    # Alloy agent config
    alloy_enabled: ${alloy_enabled}
    loki_url: "${loki_url}"
    prometheus_url: "${prometheus_url}"
    alloy_username: "${alloy_username}"
    alloy_password: "${alloy_password}"

    # Shared paths
    sidecars_dir: /config/sidecars
    compose_file: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Create Sidecar Directory
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ sidecars_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Unified Docker Compose
    # =========================================================================
    # Single compose file with all enabled agents to prevent --remove-orphans
    # from removing the "other" agent when updating just one.

    - name: Deploy unified agents docker-compose
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          # =============================================================================
          # Container Management Agents - ${container_name}
          # =============================================================================
          # Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          # =============================================================================

          services:
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Pulse Docker Agent - Container Monitoring
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # NOTE: pulse-docker-agent is deprecated. Pulse v5.0+ introduces a unified
            # agent (binary install). Until v5.0 is stable, continue using this image.
            pulse-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:v5.0.0-rc.4
              container_name: pulse-agent
              pid: host
              uts: host
              environment:
                - PULSE_URL=${pulse_url}
                - PULSE_TOKEN=${pulse_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep pulse-docker-agent || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Arcane Agent - Remote Container Management
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            arcane-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
              container_name: arcane-agent
              ports:
                - "3553:3553"
              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - arcane_agent_data:/app/data
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.5'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3553/api/health || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Alloy Agent - Log Collection to Loki
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - --disable-reporting=true
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test:
                  - CMD-SHELL
                  - |
                    bash -c '
                    exec 42<>/dev/tcp/localhost/12345;
                    echo -e "GET /-/healthy HTTP/1.1\nHost: localhost\nConnection: close\n\n" >&42;
                    head -1 <&42 | cut -d" " -f2 | grep -q "^200$$" || exit 1;
                    exec 42<&-;
                    exec 42>&-'
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s
%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          volumes:
            arcane_agent_data:
%{ endif ~}
        dest: "{{ compose_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
      register: compose_file_result

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Alloy Configuration
    # =========================================================================
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Deploy Alloy River configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          // =============================================================================
          // Grafana Alloy Configuration - ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})
          // =============================================================================
          // Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          // DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          // Config version: 2 (auth + metrics)
          // =============================================================================

          // Docker Log Discovery
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

          discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            // Keep container name as label
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            // Add compose service name if available
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
              target_label  = "service"
            }

            // Add LXC identifier
            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }

    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
